arxiv-2012-03695.title: Non-Asymptotic Performance Analysis of Size-Based Routing Policies
arxiv-2012-03695.creator: Eitan Bachmat, Josu Doncel
arxiv-2012-03695.description: Abstract We investigate the performance of two size-based routing policies: the Size Interval Task Assignment (SITA) and Task Assignment based on Guessing Size (TAGS). We consider a system with two servers and Bounded Pareto distributed job sizes with tail parameter 1 where the difference between the size of the largest and the smallest job is finite.

arxiv-2108-03149.title: On K-K-W Type Theorems for Conformal Perturbations of Twisted Dirac Operators
arxiv-2108-03149.creator: Jian Wang, Yong Wang
arxiv-2108-03149.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove two Kastler-Kalau-Walze type theorems for conformal perturbations of twisted Dirac operators and conformal perturbations of twisted signature operators on four-dimensional manifolds with (resp. without) boundary. 1 Introduction The noncommutative residue found in Gu , Wo plays a prominent role in noncommutative geometry.

arxiv-2108-04355.title: Hyperparameter Analysis for Derivative Compressive Sampling
arxiv-2108-04355.creator: Md Fazle Rabbi mrabbi@fordham.edu
arxiv-2108-04355.description: Abstract Derivative compressive sampling (DCS) is a signal reconstruction method from measurements of spatial gradient with sub-Nyquist sampling rate. Applications of DCS include optical image reconstruction, photometric stereo, and shape-from-shading. In this work, we study sensitivity of DCS with respect to algorithmic hyperparameters using brute-force search algorithm.

arxiv-2108-13306.title: Modeling material transport regulation and traffic jam in neurons using PDE-constrained optimization
arxiv-2108-13306.creator: Angran Li, Yongjie Jessica Zhang*
arxiv-2108-13306.description: Abstract The intracellular transport process plays an important role in delivering essential materials throughout branched geometries of neurons for their survival and function. Many neurodegenerative diseases have been associated with the disruption of transport. Therefore, it is essential to study how neurons control the transport process to localize materials to necessary locations.

arxiv-2109-13192.title: Consistency Training of Multi-exit Architectures for Sensor Data CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning CCS: Human-centered computing Ubiquitous and mobile computing systems and tools
arxiv-2109-13192.creator: Aaqib Saeed
arxiv-2109-13192.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Aaqib Saeed. Deep neural networks have become larger over the years with increasing demand of computational resources for inference; incurring exacerbate costs and leaving little room for deployment on devices with limited battery and other resources for real-time applications. The multi-exit architectures are type of deep neural network that are interleaved with several output (or exit) layers at varying depths of the model.

arxiv-2211-12186.title: Chow groups of surfaces of lines in cubic fourfolds
arxiv-2211-12186.creator: D. Huybrechts
arxiv-2211-12186.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by D. Huybrechts. The surface of lines in a cubic fourfold intersecting a fixed line splits motivically into two parts, one of which resembles a K3 surface. We define the analogue of the Beauville–Voisin class and study the push-forward map to the Fano variety of all lines with respect to the natural splitting of the Bloch–Beilinson filtration introduced by Mingmin Shen and Charles Vial. Cubic fourfolds, Fano variety of lines, Chow groups, Bloch conjecture, Beauville–Voisin class

2020 Mathematics Subject Classification.

arxiv-2306-15850.title: SpotEM: Efficient Video Search for Episodic Memory
arxiv-2306-15850.creator: Santhosh Kumar Ramakrishnan, Ziad Al-Halah, Kristen Grauman
arxiv-2306-15850.description: Abstract The goal in episodic memory (EM) is to search a long egocentric video to answer a natural language query (e.g., “where did I leave my purse?” ). Existing EM methods exhaustively extract expensive fixed-length clip features to look everywhere in the video for the answer, which is infeasible for long wearable-camera videos that span hours or even days.

arxiv-2310-06019.title: Waiting for Inflation: A New Initial State for the Universe
arxiv-2310-06019.creator: Brandon Melcher, Arnab Pradhan, Scott Watson
arxiv-2310-06019.description: Abstract We propose a cosmological lingering phase for the initial state prior to inflation which would help address the singularity problem of inflation. The universe begins with a constant (Hagedorn) temperature and then transitions into an inflationary universe while preserving the Null Energy Condition (NEC).

arxiv-2310-09025.title: Survey on Near-Space Information Networks: Channel Modeling, Transmission, and Networking Perspectives Thanks: X. Cao and P. Yang, and X. Su are with the School of Electronic and Information Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing 100191, China. X. Cao and P. Yang are also with the Department of Ma
arxiv-2310-09025.creator: Xianbin Cao, Xiaoning Su, Peng Yang
arxiv-2310-09025.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Xianbin Cao, Xiaoning Su, Peng Yang. Near-space information networks (NSINs) composed of high-altitude platforms (HAPs) and high- and low-altitude unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are a new regime for providing quick, robust, and cost-efficient sensing and communication services. Precipitated by innovations and breakthroughs in manufacturing, materials, communications, electronics, and control techniques, NSINs have been envisioned as an essential component of the emerging sixth-generation of mobile communication systems.

arxiv-2404-08839.title: Multiply-Robust Causal Change Attribution
arxiv-2404-08839.creator: Victor Quintas-Martinez, Mohammad Taha Bahadori, Eduardo Santiago, Jeff Mu, Dominik Janzing, David Heckerman
arxiv-2404-08839.description: Abstract Comparing two samples of data, we observe a change in the distribution of an outcome variable. In the presence of multiple explanatory variables, how much of the change can be explained by each possible cause? We develop a new estimation strategy that, given a causal model, combines regression and re-weighting methods to quantify the contribution of each causal mechanism.

arxiv-2504-04760.title: The spin measurement of the black hole SLX 1746-331 using Insight -HXMT observations
arxiv-2504-04760.creator: Jiashi Chen, Wei Wang
arxiv-2504-04760.description: Abstract We present an X-ray spectral analysis of a black hole X-ray binary SLX 1746-331 during the 2023 outburst using five Insight -HXMT observations. We jointly use the reflection model relxillcp and the general relativistic thermal thin disk model kerrbb to fit the spectra from 2 - 100 keV.

arxiv-2507-20431.title: On the surface Bloch waves in truncated periodic media
arxiv-2507-20431.creator: Bojan B. Guzina, Shixu Meng, Prasanna Salasiya, Long Nguyen
arxiv-2507-20431.description: Abstract Much like their counterparts in elastic solids, waves in periodic media can be broadly classified into Floquet-Bloch body waves , and evanescent surface waves . Our goal is to elucidate the latter boundary layers, termed surface Bloch (SB) waves, affiliated with rational surface cuts and homogeneous Neumann data.

arxiv-2509-23955.title: ColLab: A Collaborative Spatial Progressive Data Engine for Referring Expression Comprehension and Generation
arxiv-2509-23955.creator: Shilan Zhang, Jirui Huang, Ruilin Yao, Cong Wang, Yaxiong Chen, Peng Xu, Shengwu Xiong
arxiv-2509-23955.description: Abstract Referring Expression Comprehension (REC) and Referring Expression Generation (REG) are fundamental tasks in multimodal understanding, supporting precise object localization through natural language. However, existing REC and REG datasets rely heavily on manual annotation, which is labor-intensive and difficult to scale.

arxiv-2511-15931.title: Generation of spin-squeezed states using dipole-coupled spins
arxiv-2511-15931.creator: Yifan Song, Nabiha Hasan, Susumu Takahashi
arxiv-2511-15931.description: Abstract Spins in solids and molecules are promising for applications of quantum sensing technology. The sensitivity of the quantum sensing depends on how precisely spin observables can be determined in the measurement, and is intrinsically limited by the uncertainties of the observables.

arxiv-2512-13783.title: Confirming membership in Local Group galaxies with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 1 2026 Confirming membership in Local Group galaxies with the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 1 – References
arxiv-2512-13783.creator: Federico Sestito & Chiaki Kobayashi
arxiv-2512-13783.description: Abstract We use the Dark Energy Spectroscopic Instrument Data Release 1 (DESI DR1) to identify stellar members of the Local Group dwarf galaxies. We cross-match DESI targets with candidate members that are based on Gaia proper motions, positions, and photometry. The addition of DESI radial velocities enables secure membership determination in 16 systems, spanning ultra-faint, classical, and irregular dwarf galaxies.

pmc-10649052.title: Comparative Transcriptome Analysis between Resistant and Susceptible Pakchoi Cultivars in Response to Downy Mildew
pmc-10649052.creator: Yaosong Chen, Liming Miao, Xiaofeng Li, Yiwen Liu, Dandan Xi, Dingyu Zhang, Lu Gao, Yuying Zhu, Shaojun Dai, Hongfang Zhu, Yong-Gu Cho
pmc-10649052.description: Downy mildew caused by the obligate parasite Hyaloperonospora brassicae is a devastating disease for Brassica species. pmc-11525704.creator: Alisara Wongsuttilert, Ruchirek Thamcharoen, Yoswanich Maiprasert, Sathapakorn Siriwong
